actually_viewed.finding: Board and hover show zero combat damage with the nearby-gear explanation and Beginner advice.
Pinned full face distinguishes 4 Might from 0 combat damage and explains the missing friendly gear; scrolling remains available.
Pinned face shows 4 Might and 4 combat damage when exhausted gear is attached to another friendly unit here, with the met requirement and Advanced advice.

visual_review.scope: Native hover, right-click inspector, close, and reopened inspector in normal and small windows. Gear fixture changes between frames; this UI extension does not claim to exercise a new gear action control.

release.source_note: Release and complete-suite source was frozen before two test-only corrections. Reversing those exact corrections reproduces the frozen source hashes; no production behavior changed.

rules_review: The two full official faces agree on 3 Energy, 0 Power, 4 Might, Calm, champion unit, Orianna/Piltover, Shield and the gear requirement. The alternate omits only the Shield reminder; no field correction or erratum is applied.
Core 135.2.d.1-3 and 814.1 establish reminder equivalence and Shield 1 while defending. Zero combat contribution does not reduce reference Might or the damage needed for lethal.
Core 719.3/a places an attachment at its bearer location. Gear attached to Orianna or a different friendly unit counts; its stored prior lane is not the physical location.

Friendly uses controller identity under 740.1.a. Unattached gear and Gold here count; enemy gear, other locations and facedown cards do not. Readiness and inactive printed gear abilities do not remove presence.
Actual Equip and Move actions, effect Recall, and removal of the last gear during a showdown update the condition before damage. Stun independently prevents combat damage.
Fight uses current Might even without gear. Tokens sharing a storage card ID do not acquire the printed restriction.
Both player API views report the same public requirement and current contribution. Validation remains read-only, and ordinary units retain their existing object shape.
Beginner and Advanced advice explain the interaction without using opponent hidden information. Native board and inspector distinguish Might, zero contribution, and the current requirement.
findings_resolved: The full Rust run found one stale catalog-size assertion. The corrected full library passed all 762 tests, bringing the unique all-target total to 1572.
Two Python history tests assumed Pyke remained the final review and retained predecessor review counts. Both are corrected without modifying any historical receipt or review object.

Initial focused fixtures guessed an unavailable gear-ID field, used incorrect or ineligible spell IDs, and expected Orianna to survive a Fight against greater Might. These fixtures were corrected before the complete suite; runtime behavior was unchanged.
The API fixture initially tried to Pass after a permanent play with no response window. It now passes only while a chain exists.
limitations: This adds a custom-deck card, not a newly verified Irelia tournament preset. The Arito Convergence IV list is an attributed secondary-source lead; primary standings and deck provenance are not yet independently captured.
This acceptance uses native x86-64 Linux. The separate Nix acceptance remains the Back Off source at 6411bd141a3bff35eb6491e2a6202496045030bf, recorded in irelia_backoff_nix.json.
The accepted dated card catalog remains in use while duplicate live publisher printing IDs are unresolved. The current rules/errata comparison is not a new full-gallery acceptance.
Complete Standard parity, all legal cards, individual combat attribution, best-of-three sideboarding and tournament-strength AI remain unfinished.
